messages:
maria (docs): Quick heads-up 1: infra changed the offline bundle layout in the latest build. Examples in private/install and the HSM quickstart are now stale.
sam (infra): Yep, we moved runtime libs into /vendor/runtime and split the KMS client into its own tarball (`redwood-kms-client-2026.04.02.tgz`). Also normalized the PKCS#11 socket to `/run/redwood/pkcs11.sock`.
maria (docs): thanks. I'll update extraction examples, systemd snippet, and the SDK examples that hardcode the socket.
aj (eng): can you paste the new extract commands so I can double-check paths?
sam (infra): sure:
```
# new offline unpack steps
mkdir -p /opt/redwood /opt/redwood/vendor
tar -xzf redwood-offline-runtime-2026.04.02.tgz -C /opt/redwood
tar -xzf redwood-kms-client-2026.04.02.tgz -C /opt/redwood/vendor
# verify checksums
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pubkey.pem -signature SHA256SUMS.sig SHA256SUMS
```
maria (docs): good. ci-bot flagged that current docs reference `/opt/redwood/lib` and `/var/run/pkcs11`. I'll send a PR with: updated tarball names, new vendor paths, PKCS#11 path change, and a migration note for onprem customers.
kevin (security): add a short how-to for verifying the bundle: import the GPG pubkey and run `gpg --verify SHA256SUMS.sig SHA256SUMS`. Also add the official fingerprint: `3F2A9B8C4D127E9012AB4CDE98F1334B5E6A7C2D`.
maria (docs): noted. I'll add the curl | gpg import snippet and the fingerprint to frontmatter.
aj (eng): small note on HSM permissions: systemd now uses `RuntimeDirectory=redwood` and runs as `redwood` user. Recommend adding an ExecStartPost to chown the socket and ensure group `hsm` has rw.
maria (docs): adding systemd override example in the PR: 
```
[Service]
RuntimeDirectory=redwood
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
ExecStartPost=/bin/chown redwood:hsm /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock || true
```

sam (infra): for immediate upgrades we suggested a temporary symlink `ln -s /run/redwood/pkcs11.sock /var/run/pkcs11` but mark it as deprecated in the migration guide. Prefer customers update their HSM config.
kevin (security): agree. include both: preferred is config change; symlink only as rollback. Also mention ACLs and systemd tmpfiles if admins want persistent permissions on reboot.
ci-bot: docs lint results: private/install.md example-snippet-check failed (referenced path /opt/redwood/lib). Also flagged missing verification instructions for SHA256SUMS.
maria (docs): thanks CI. PR plan: 1) update private/install.md snippets (tarball + paths), 2) add HSM socket + systemd override example, 3) add checksum + gpg verify snippet + fingerprint, 4) add SDK config examples (python/go) showing socket path, 5) include migration note with symlink and ACL guidance. I'll target a draft in ~3 hours.
aj (eng): ping me when ready, I'll do a quick tech review. If merged before EOD we can put it in release notes.
sam (infra): I'll also drop a tiny helper `redwood-inspect-bundle` into the installer repo that prints layout and recommended paths; docs can link to it.
maria (docs): perfect. thanks all :raised_hands:
